---
# Copy this file to songs/<title-of-song>.qmd and fill in what you know.
# Only `title` is required. Leave any other field empty, or delete it, and the
# song page skips it.

title: ""             # capitalize the first letter of every word: "Bird On A Wire"
sort_title: ""        # how it sorts, e.g. "Banana Boat Song, The"; empty = title
artist: ""
key: ""               # key the song is written in below, e.g. G or Em
alt_keys: []          # other keys to list first in the key menu, e.g. [C]
key_note: ""          # e.g. "easier for Andy to sing"
youtube: ""           # full YouTube URL
libraries: [all]      # add any of: spiritual, andy-original, yeastbombs, kids, kids-motions

difficulty:           # 0–5
practice:             # 1–7: how much Andy wants to practise it
fun:                  # 1–3: how fun it is to play
skill:                # how well Andy plays it
poppy:                # 1–3
happy:                # 1–3
spiritual:            # 1–3
protest:              # 1–3

voice_low: ""         # Andy's Voice: lowest note sung, e.g. G2 (C4 = middle C)
voice_high: ""        # Andy's Voice: highest note sung, e.g. D4

added: ""             # year and month, e.g. 2026-10
other_links: []       # links to elsewhere, e.g. a PDF
files: []             # files kept here, e.g. [files/my-song.xlsx]
---

```{.song}
Verse 1:
[G] Lyrics with [C] chords in square [D] brackets | 1 2 3  3 2 1  5. 1
A line can have a melody after " | ", or not

Chorus:
# A line starting with # is a note, e.g. # Strum: D DU UDU
```
